transition: theta_next = theta - h_code * P * g / 2 + sqrt(h_code) * chol(P) * z
initialization: all independent replicas start at the same frozen mode estimate

adaptive_baseline.variant: Li-style practical Gamma-omitted RMSprop; constant step in each run
adaptive_baseline.raw_gradient: unscaled minibatch mean likelihood gradient, excluding prior and CV correction
adaptive_baseline.ess_policy: exploratory only; fixed-metric theory does not cover this arm

accuracy.whitening: fixed mode-Hessian square root, separate from sampler metric
accuracy.replica_rule: one endpoint per independent replica at each checkpoint

functionals.coordinates: all fixed mode-Hessian-whitened coordinate means and variances
functionals.slow_direction: mean and variance along minimum-eigenvalue direction of mode Hessian
functionals.predictions: 8 frozen uniformly sampled design rows for logistic targets; no prediction-performance claim
functionals.variance_estimator: mean(q^2) - mean(q)^2; no iid Bessel correction
functionals.normalization: calibration reference SD of q for means, SD of (q-Eq)^2 for variances, SD of probability for predictions; floor 1e-8
functionals.aggregation: report each functional plus family mean and family maximum normalized RMSE
functionals.reference_uncertainty: independent-reference functional disagreement; HMC MCSE for each functional

reference.gaussian: exact iid; analytic functional expectations; calibration and scoring streams separate
reference.limitations: HMC reference is approximate and correlated; diagnostics and independent agreement are required, not proof of exactness

failure.rule: nonfinite transition or radius above 100*sqrt(d) fails replica permanently; no clipping, replacement, filtering, or automatic retuning
failure.checkpoint: any failed replica invalidates entire endpoint ensemble and RMSE from that point onward
failure.reference: failed reference validation stops target evaluation and remains recorded
failure.budget: unreached precision at frozen cap is censored, not extrapolated

cost.secondary: separate operation counts; no conversion to gradient-equivalent FLOPs
cost.setup_charged: once per method ensemble, includes mode and method-required caches/metric; reuse within ensemble allowed
cost.conditional_cost: sampling-only separately reported; not substituted for first-use cost
cost.rmse_scope: single-chain sequential cost is a distinct measured experiment; never divide ensemble setup-inclusive time by replica count
cost.gpu: CPU float64 one BLAS thread in phase1; any GPU backend requires a separately frozen hardware/precision/timing validation
cost.tuning: Record per-method search cost separately and also search-inclusive total; selected-configuration frontier excludes parameter search but includes all intrinsic setup.
cost.profiling: Component timers are nested subsets, not added to wall time; all P0 smoke arms profiled equally. Production frontiers use unprofiled wall time and separate profiles.

validation.scope: correctness and pipeline validation only; no efficiency or mixing superiority claims

next_stage_candidate_rules.status: candidate rules frozen; production target assets and resolved grid require their own lock before selection/evaluation
next_stage_candidate_rules.selection: selection seeds choose finite-grid configurations separately by method and budget; heldout seeds evaluate frozen choices only
next_stage_candidate_rules.tie_break: lower selection RMSE, then lower measured cost, then smaller step, then shorter run
next_stage_candidate_rules.failures: keep failed candidates in complete point cloud; exclude from eligible frontier, never average over surviving seeds only
next_stage_candidate_rules.practical_advantage: at least 10 percent cost reduction at matched prespecified accuracy, with paired uncertainty; absence of significance is not equivalence
next_stage_candidate_rules.accuracy_thresholds: must be frozen after reference-resolution pilot and before selection seeds; phase1 smoke does not select these thresholds

public_transition: theta_next = theta - h * P * g + sqrt(2*h) * chol(P) * z

uncertainty.scope: pointwise percentile intervals for finite-cloud statistics; no simultaneous frontier bands or guaranteed population-W2 coverage
uncertainty.resampling_unit: whole independent replica paths; preserve paired method indices and checkpoint dependence
uncertainty.aggregate: outer algorithm-seed clusters, inner paired replicas; do not flatten reference-sharing seed clusters
uncertainty.reference_resampling: none; report independent HMC MCSE/disagreement separately
uncertainty.failure_policy: any failed seed/replica invalidates aggregate comparison; no survivor filtering
uncertainty.validation_checkpoints: final checkpoint only; validation is an execution check, not inferential evidence

theory_policy.identity_and_fixed_P: empirical comparisons valid; theorem-derived superiority/step thresholds require claim-specific audit
theory_policy.li2016: empirical Gamma-omitted extension; no fixed-P invariant-law guarantee
theory_policy.N_scaling: upper-bound hypotheses, not exact empirical exponents; no O(N^-1) actual work claim
theory_policy.main_target: large-N non-quadratic GLM; current Gaussian-likelihood YearMSD is P4 support only
